qe: In October 1763, the English prisoners kept at Patna were put to death on the orders of which Nawab of Bengal, an event known as the Patna massacre?
qh: अक्टूबर 1763 में पटना में रखे अंग्रेज कैदियों को किस बंगाल के नवाब के आदेश पर मार डाला गया, जिसे 'पटना नरसंहार' कहा जाता है?
e: 1763 me Patna me angreji kaidiyon ka narsankhar Nawab Mir Kasim ke aadesh par hua. Us samay Mir Kasim Bangal ka Nawab tha tatha angrejon se lad raha tha. Jab angreji sena aage badh rahi thi tatha Patna par khatra badh raha tha, usne 5 October 1763 ko kaidiyon ko maar dene ka hukm diya. Nawab ke Hindustani sipahiyon tatha afsaron ne yah ghatiya kaam karne se inkar kar diya, isliye Walter Reinhardt, jise 'Somroo' kaha jaata tha, ne kuch logon ke saath mil kar yah kaam karaya. Isi tarah 11 October ko Chahal Situn me rakhe bimar tatha ghayal kaidiyon ko maara gaya, jinme sirf Dr. Fullarton bach paye. Yah ghatna dikhati hai ki us daur me Bihar ki rajdhani kshetra me angrej-Nawab sangharsh kitna tez tha. Exam point: Patna narsankhar = 5 October 1763, aadesh Nawab Mir Kasim ka; kaam Walter Reinhardt (Somroo) ne karaya; 11 October ko Chahal Situn ke bimar kaidi mare gaye, sirf Dr. Fullarton bache.

qe: After the fall of Patna in November 1763, Nawab Mir Kasim fled to which neighbouring region for shelter and help?
qh: नवंबर 1763 में पटना गिरने के बाद नवाब मीर कासिम किस पड़ोसी क्षेत्र में शरण तथा सहायता के लिए भागा?
e: 1763 me Patna ka kila angreji sena ke haath me chala gaya tatha Mir Kasim ko wahan se bagna pada. Woh Awadh ke Nawab Shuja-ud-daula ke paas pahuncha, jahan use ashray tatha sena ki madad mili. Patna par hamle ka netritva Major Adams ne kiya tha: 28 October 1763 ko angreji sena shahar ke saamne pahunchi, 5 November tak uttar-purab darwaze tatha purab taraf se deewar me chaid ban gaye tatha 6 November ko kila zabardasti haasil kar liya gaya. Kuch samay baad command Randfurlie Knox ko mili, lekin woh bimar the tatha 28 January 1764 ko Bankipore me unka nidhan ho gaya. Aage Mir Kasim, Awadh ke Nawab Shuja-ud-daula tatha Mughal badshah Shah Alam teeno ki sanyukt sena ne angrejon ka saamna kiya, jiska nateeja 1764 me Buxar ki nirnayak ladai me nikla. Nepal, Bangal tatha Kaimur pahadiyaan aise ashray ka sthal nahi thi. Exam point: Patna ka kila November 1763 me Major Adams ne liya; Mir Kasim Awadh (Shuja-ud-daula ke paas) bhaga; Randfurlie Knox ka nidhan 28 January 1764 ko Bankipore me hua.

qe: The decisive battle of Buxar (1764), which made the British masters of Bihar and Bengal, was won under the command of which British officer?
qh: बिहार तथा बंगाल में अंग्रेजों का प्रभुत्व स्थापित करने वाली बक्सर की निर्णायक लड़ाई (1764) किस अंग्रेज अफसर के नेतृत्व में जीती गई?
e: 23 October 1764 ko Buxar ki ladai me Major Hector Munro ki aguvai me angreji sena ne Mir Kasim, Awadh ke Nawab Shuja-ud-daula tatha Mughal badshah Shah Alam ki sanyukt sena ko poora hara diya. Isi vijay ke baad angrej Bihar tatha Bangal ke asli shasak ban gaye. Isse pehle 1763 me Patna ke paas bhi morche bane the, jahan Major Adams ne kila liya; uske baad March se May 1764 ke beech Carnac ki command me angreji sena ne kai morche sambhale. Robert Clive 1765 me Bangal aaye tatha unhone Bengal, Bihar tatha Orissa ki diwani hasil ki, saath hi prashasan me bade badlav kiye. Robert Barker tatha Warren Hastings is ladai ke sena-neta nahi the. Isliye sahi uttar Hector Munro hai. Exam point: Buxar ki ladai 23 October 1764 = angreji sena ke sardar Hector Munro; iske baad 1765 me Clive ne Bengal, Bihar tatha Orissa ki diwani hasil ki; Patna ka kila 1763 me Major Adams ne liya tha.

qe: During the famine of 1770, which naib diwan of Bihar proposed setting apart two lakh rupees for relief work at Patna?
qh: 1770 के अकाल के दौरान बिहार के किस नायब दीवान ने पटना में राहत-कार्य के लिए दो लाख रुपये अलग रखने का प्रस्ताव रखा?
e: 1769 ke ant me Bihar me akal ke sanket dikhne lage; patjhad (autumnal) ki barsaat waqt se pehle band ho jane se khadi fasalein nasht ho gayi. 1770 me Patna me halat itni kharab ho gayi ki Shitab Rai ne bataya ki roz pachas log bhookh se mar rahe hain, tatha aage ke vivaranon me ek din me ek sau pachas mauton ka zikr milta hai. Company ke naib diwan tatha Bihar ke bade adhikari Shitab Rai ne saaf taur par do lakh rupaye rahat-karya ke liye alag rakhne ka prastav rakha, lekin Calcutta ki sarkar ne na jimmedari li tatha na us prastav ko saaf manzoori di. Akal ke isi daur me 1770 me Patna ka Revenue Council banaya gaya, jiska president James Alexander the tatha Robert Palk tatha George Vansittart uske member the; Shitab Rai nizamat yaani prashasan ke prabhari rahe. November 1770 me raiyaton ne renters ke zulm ki shikayat ki, jis par council ne lagan ki uchchatam seema utpadan ke nau-solah hisson (9/16) par tay kar di. Phir bhi sarkar ne utpadan ka bada hissa lagan ke roop me lene ki kathor neeti jaari rakhi, jisse kisanon ki halat aur bigadi. Raja Ram Narayan ko Mir Kasim ne marwaya tha, Dheraj Narain usi ka bhai tha tatha Mir Kasim Nawab tha. Exam point: 1770 ki akal me Patna me roz 50 se 150 tak mauten hoti thi; Bihar ke naib diwan Shitab Rai ne 2 lakh rupaye rahat-karya ka prastav diya; Calcutta ki sarkar ne yah prastav turant manzoor nahi kiya.

qe: Which three dangers for Pataliputra did the Buddha foretell when he visited the fortified village of Patali on the Ganga?
qh: गंगा किनारे पाटली गाँव में जाने पर बुद्ध ने पाटलिपुत्र के लिए किन तीन खतरों की भविष्यवाणी की थी?
e: Ajatashatru ne Lichchhavi ganrajya ko qaboo me rakhne ke liye Ganga ke dakshin tat par Patali gaon me ek kila banwaya tha. Apni mrityu se kuch maheene pehle Bhagwan Buddha yahan aaye tatha unhone is kila-bandh gaon ke liye bhavishyavani ki, bharat ke sabhi prasiddh sthalon tatha vyapar ke kendron me Pataliputra sabse bada hoga, lekin ise teen khatre ghere rahenge - aag, baadh tatha aapas ka jhagda. Lagbhag aadhe shatabdi baad Ajatashatru ke pote Udayin ne rajdhani Rajgir se yahin sthanantarit kar di, kyunki vyapar tatha raksha ki drishti se Ganga-kinara yah sthal sabse upyukt tha. Aage yahi shahar Maurya, Gupta tatha Pala kaalon me bharat ke rajnetik kendra ke roop me chamka tatha aaj Bihar ki rajdhani Patna usi sthal par basa hai. Aise varnan prachin sahitya tatha Bauddh parampara se milte hain. Exam point: Buddha ki bhavishyavani = Pataliputra ke liye teen khatre - aag, baadh tatha aapas ka jhagda; kila Ajatashatru ne Patali gaon me banwaya tatha Udayin ne rajdhani Rajgir se Pataliputra sthanantarit ki.

qe: In which year was Patna renamed Azimabad, after a Mughal prince who was then governor of the area?
qh: किस वर्ष पटना का नाम 'आजिमाबाद' रखा गया, जो उस समय यहाँ के गवर्नर रहे एक मुगल शहज़ादे के नाम पर था?
e: Aurangzeb ke pote Shahzade Azim-us-Shan (Muhammad Azim) jab Bihar ke gavarnar the, tab unhone Patna ka naam badal kar Azimabad rakh diya; yah ghatna lagbhag 1704 ki maani jaati hai. Us daur se pehle Patna par Daud Khan jaise gavarnaron ke vidroh, Maratha hamle tatha vyapari companies ke aagman jaise kai jhatke pade the, isliye shahar ki deewar tatha kila-bandi ko baar-baar theek karana pada. Azimabad ka naam zyada samay tak nahi chala; angreji kaal tatha aaj bhi shahar Patna hi kehlata hai, lekin kuch bazar tatha mohalle abhi bhi Azimabad naam se jaane jaate hain. Diye gaye anya varsh alag ghatnaon se jude hain - 1658 Shahjahan ke uttaradhikar ke sangharsh ka, 1739 Nadir Shah ke hamle ka tatha 1761 Panipat ki ladai ka. Isliye sahi uttar 1704 hai. Exam point: Patna ka naam Azimabad = lagbhag 1704, Shahzade Azim-us-Shan (Aurangzeb ke pote) dwara; woh us samay Bihar ke gavarnar the; aaj bhi kuch bazar-mohalle Azimabad naam se jaane jaate hain.

qe: During the 1857 revolt, European residents of Bankipore near Patna gathered for safety at which garden house, then the residence of Commissioner William Tayler?
qh: 1857 के विद्रोह के दौरान पटना के निकट बांकीपुर के यूरोपीय निवासी सुरक्षा के लिए किस बाग-भवन में एकत्र हुए थे, जो उस समय कमिश्नर विलियम टेलर का निवास था?
e: 1857 ke vidroh ke dauran Patna mandal ke Commissioner William Tayler Bankipore ke Chajju Bagh bhawan me rehte the. Dinapur se khatre ki khabar milne par 7 June 1857 ko Bankipore ke European nivasi tay yojna ke mutabik Chajju Bagh me ikattha ho gaye tatha woh raat badee ashanti tatha chinta me kati, kyunki pahredari me lage kuch sipahi tatha Holmes ke kuch sowar shakkiy maane ja rahe the. Agle din, 8 June ki subah 4 baje, Captain Rattray apne Sikh sipahiyon ke saath pahunch gaye, jisse wah raat ke baad logon ko suraksha mili. 18 June ko Tayler ne isi Chajju Bagh se Maulaviyon ko giraftar kiya. Gulzar Bagh, Company Bagh tatha Jafar Khan ka bagh anya sthal hain, jahan aisi ikattha-gathering nahi hui. Exam point: 1857 me Bankipore ke European nivasi 7 June ko Chajju Bagh (Commissioner William Tayler ka nivas) me ikattha hue; 8 June ko Captain Rattray Sikh sipahiyon ke saath pahunche; 18 June ko Maulaviyon ki giraftari wahi se hui.

qe: In September 1781, which leader, at the head of five thousand followers, began to plunder the country around Patna and was routed by Captain Powell in the Guma pass?
qh: सितंबर 1781 में कौन-सा नेता पाँच हजार अनुयायियों के साथ पटना के आसपास लूटपाट करने लगा था, जिसे कैप्टन पॉवेल ने गुमा दर्रे में हराया?
e: 22 August 1781 ko Patna me Chait Singh ke vidroh ki khabar pahunchi, jisse shahar me kaafi halchal hui; Chait Singh Banaras ke zamindar the, jinhone angreji sarkar ke viruddh bagawat ki thi. Patna tatha aas-paas ke kshetra me unke paksh me kuch logon ne saazish bhi ki, lekin khul kar saath dene wale do bade zamindar hi the - Siris-Kutumba ke Narain Singh tatha Hasua parivar se jude Iqbal Ali Khan. Narain Singh ne apni zamindari par sena khadi ki tatha Captain James Crawfurd ki Grand Trunk Road par badhne wali sena ka saamna karne ki koshish ki. Iske baad September 1781 me Iqbal Ali Khan paanch hazaar anuyayiyon ke saath kshetra me lootpat shuru kar di. Captain Powell ne Dinapore se teen companies ke saath Rajauli ke paas Guma darre me unhe poora hara diya; Iqbal Ali Khan Kharakdiha bhaag gaya tatha aage Delhi chala gaya. Aise vidroh dikhate hain ki Permanent Settlement se pehle Bihar me zamindari parivaron ki apni sena tatha sarkari faujdon ke beech takrao aam baat thi. Exam point: 1781 me Chait Singh ke vidroh ka asar Patna tak pahuncha; khul kar saath dene wale bade zamindar = Narain Singh tatha Iqbal Ali Khan; Iqbal Ali Khan paanch hazaar anuyayiyon ke saath lootpat karta hua Captain Powell dwara Guma darre (Rajauli ke paas) me hara diya gaya tatha woh Kharakdiha hokar Delhi chala gaya.

qe: The Permanent Settlement, whose working in Bihar began in the last decade of the 18th century, was introduced by which Governor-General?
qh: बिहार में जिसका कार्य 18वीं सदी के अंतिम दशक में शुरू हुआ, वह स्थायी बंदोबस्त किस गवर्नर-जनरल ने लागू किया?
e: Permanent Settlement yaani sthai bandobast 1793 me Lord Cornwallis ke samay lagu hua. Is vyavastha me zamindaron ko jameen ki milkiyat tatha nirdharit lagan dene ki jimmedari di gayi; badle me sarkar ko har saal utni hi lagan milti thi, chahe fasal achhi ho ya kharab. Bihar me iski prakriya 18vein sadi ke antim dashak me chali tatha aage naye kshetron me record-of-rights banaye gaye, jisse zamindar, raiyat tatha kashtkar ke adhikar likhit roop me darj hue. Isse pehle 1765 me Bengal, Bihar tatha Orissa ki diwani angrejon ko mili thi tatha uske baad ke saalon me lagan-nirdharan tatha mukarrari bandobast jaise kai kadam liye gaye. Sthir lagan se zamindaron ko faayda hua, lekin chhote kisanon tatha bataidaron par dabav bhi badha, jo aage kisan andolanon ki ek vajah bana. Warren Hastings diwani lene se jude the tatha Wellesley tatha Dalhousie ki neetiyan alag thi. Exam point: Permanent Settlement 1793 = Lord Cornwallis; zamindaron ko jameen ki milkiyat tatha nirdharit lagan; Bihar me iski prakriya 18vein sadi ke antim dashak me; record-of-rights se adhikar likhit roop me darj hue.
